requirements.quote: Your job is to verify its SHA-256 checksum and create a log file at `/home/user/qa_resources/checksum_verification.log` with the results.
The log file must contain **exactly** the four lines shown in the format below.
The `<calculated>` value should be the actual digest of the file.
*   The order of the lines must be exactly as shown.
*   No extra spaces, blank lines, or additional text are allowed.
*   The file must end with a single trailing newline (i.e., Unix LF).

check.cmd:
test "$(tail -c1 /home/user/qa_resources/checksum_verification.log | od -An -c | tr -d ' ')" = '
' && test "$(tail -c2 /home/user/qa_resources/checksum_verification.log | od -An -c | tr -d ' ')" != '

' && ! grep -q "$(printf '')" /home/user/qa_resources/checksum_verification.log
